components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized by stripping every non-digit character and must contain
            exactly 10 digits after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner

## Summary

I implemented optional owner email support so the app satisfies the spec and all tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 3/3 acceptance tests green).

**What the spec required:** An owner may include `email`; when present it must be a syntactically valid address, stored/returned lower-cased; reject with 400 when present but invalid.

**Changes made:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property (`type: string`, `format: email`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Because the OpenAPI generator runs with `performBeanValidation`, `format: email` generates a `@Email` constraint on the DTO, and the generated API interface applies `@Valid` to the request body — so an invalid email (e.g. `not-an-email`) is rejected with **400** automatically, while a missing email is accepted.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — Added the `email` field with `@Column(name = "email")` and `@Email`, plus getter/setter and the import. MapStruct maps `email` automatically by name between DTO and entity.

3. **`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Lower-cased the email before persisting, mirroring the existing telephone-normalization pattern, in both `addOwner` and `updateOwner`.

4. **`db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — Added an `email` column to the `owners` table (the test profile is `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema must be explicit).

5. **`db/{hsqldb,mysql}/data.sql`** — The seed inserts used positional `INSERT ... VALUES`, which broke once a column was added. I gave them explicit column lists so `email` defaults to NULL for seed rows (h2 and postgres already used explicit column lists).

Verified end-to-end: `Test.User@Example.COM` is stored and returned as `test.user@example.com`, invalid emails yield 400, and owners without an email create successfully.
